summary: @servicetitan/link-item@41.3.6 downloads Bun runtime at preinstall to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a small React `link-item` component but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, marks it executable, and uses it to run `math_init.js` — a ~727KB single-line file heavily obfuscated with an obfuscator.io-style rotated string-array (shuffler function `WV8StW` cycling array `n7gIxM`) and randomized `_0x`/hex identifiers. Fetching an alternate JS runtime solely to execute an obfuscated, multi-hundred-KB sibling file has no relationship to a UI component library, and the use of a non-Node runtime specifically hides the executed code from Node-based static review. Installing the package causes this obfuscated payload to run automatically under the installer's account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
